notes.title: Inctroducing Astral Challenges – A Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25989976/1b3f0ad492599280675073c67b272ef5544f2de7.png

It's finally here! We’ve been working on new content for Nine Parchments ever since we first released the game, and now we're excited to present you the Astral Challenges update!

This content update is free and available now. Check out the trailer below as well as highlights from the update! 😄

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d75Afn-UnPM

 Six New Arena Levels
These missions will challenge even the most battle-hardened wizard veterans, as they are designed for characters who are at least level 40. So, you'd better be ready for a rough ride, as simply put… you will die.

 New Character
A new wizard student, Selius, can be discovered in the new arena levels along with new hats, staves and spells.

 Quick Chat Added!
This feature will make talking to your classmates as easy as pressing a button, so get ready to yell at your friends.


Full changelog on our blog with more screenshots! Are you ready wizards? 😉

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25989976/5eb84b46fc5e036d0048800de04fea79b21dd347.jpg

notes.title: New patch is now live! (Build 4230)
notes.notes:
We have just released a patch for Nine Parchments! Current build number is now 4230.

You can now store multiple runs
You can have up to ten games stored at the same time. So there is no need to overwrite your current run if you want to play with your friends for a while.

Other fixes
 A lot of bug fixes to different kinds of issues of camera not moving and enemies not spawning or dying correctly
 More fixes to saves being wiped when disconnecting from an online game
 Fixes to startup issues (like the render error)
 Fixes to custom binds not being saved properly (unfortunately currently saved custom binds will reset due to the patch)
 Other minor fixes

Please let us know if anything weird happens after the patch! You can report the bugs you're experiencing to here. :)

notes.title: Upcoming Updates to Nine Parchments + Hotfix
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/i8XLJZZ.jpg

Nine Parchments has sparked a lot of activity here and on social media channels and we’re grateful for all the comments and feedback we’ve received. Keep it coming and we'll also try to answer you as much as we can! 😊 

However we're also going to be busy with improving the game based on the said feedback. Below is a quick update on the major issues we’re tackling right now!

Multiple Saves 
We'll try to add a menu to choose where you left off. We'll try to get this out next week!
Losing Progress 
We're tacklig this issue hard and already added one fix regarding Online Multiplayer. Sorry about this, but hopefully this helps!
Online Games
Fixes already in and we’re planning to add a feature to see the latency of other players when selecting online games.
Friendly Fire
We'll try to fix issues for the Friendly Fire like it resetting while playing.

You can read more details about these upcoming changes from our blog and we'll also be considering what other updates would be necessary. Stay tuned for this!

So, one more thanks and below are some important fixes the new hotfix brought!

Hotfix (4125)

Fixes to save slot emptying when joining an online game
Fixed online games turning to single player games when pressing ”Resume Game”

notes.title: Nine Parchments Hotfix!
notes.notes:
We have released a sneak hotfix for the Steam build. You can see your build number from in-game options menu, it should be 4120 after the update.

Main fixes in this patch

Online player list works now a lot better
Joining games in general works better and shouldn't enter a vicious circle of not finding anything
Friends only games are now actually friends only games
Continuing friends only games works, remember to just press "Resume Game" 😊
You can now start a multiplayer game alone and let people hotjoin the game while you play

There are also a lot of smaller fixes, such as small level tweaks.

Also note that host can kick other players by typing /kick playername to chat. 

We plan to continue updating the game (hopefully less sneakily next time), so stay tuned. Also, if you have problems with the game email us support[at]frozenbyte[dot]com or visit the Official Bug Thread.

notes.title: Trine devs release co-op spell blaster Nine Parchments
notes.notes:
It’s a good week for aspiring mages. Yesterday I told you about the upcoming Wizard of Legend, and today I’m drawing your pupils to the new sorcery-sim from the Trine devs, Nine Parchments, which actually came out yesterday. You play as a student who must leave wizard school to chase after some stolen spells, and it looks almost as pretty as Trine did – which makes sense, because it takes place in the same world. You can see for yourself in the trailer below.
 (more…)

notes.title: Release Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/1YDcQ1f.png

It's coming very soon! Sorry to keep you waiting, but we finally have the date as the game is coming to Steam tomorrow.

If you're interested in the Switch version it will be out tomorrow, December 5th on Nintendo Switch eShop in North America and Europe, and on December 7th in Japan. The console release is digital only.

The PS4 and Xbox One release dates will be confirmed as soon as we have the information. And from tomorrow on the PC version will also be available on GOG and Humble Store as well.

Expect more info tomorrow!

https://i.imgur.com/Bktd2dh.png

notes.title: Nintendo Switch Version Announced Along with New Details!
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/MTaoD4h.jpg

We are excited to announce that Nine Parchments is coming to Nintendo Switch as well! Below is a new trailer for this. Other announced platforms are PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. There is no release date yet, but it's in 2017!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pOEKESOFOI0
As you may have noticed we've kept quiet about the game for quite some time, so it's cool to finally break the silence and show some new footage! How does the game look? 😉

Here is also a list of upcoming features!

Wield the power of the elements and master a diverse and ever-changing arsenal of spells
Unlock new playable characters, wizard hats and magical staves
Level up and train your characters in the magical arts, but choose your path wisely!
Battle strange creatures and mighty bosses in a breathtakingly beautiful world, set in the Trine universe
Online and local co-op with 1-4 players


We'll also start posting more frequent updates and info about Nine Parchments, so stay tuned! Also feel free to check out some other details and new screenshots from our blog on our website.

http://i.imgur.com/8ksywmV.jpg

PS. We'll be heading over to Hamburg in Germany in June 9-11th for Magnology where we'll have a new playable demo of Nine Parchments. So stop by if you're in the area!
